summary: AgentRun is an open‑source framework that lets developers build self‑improving AI agents via a CLI and a Python SDK. It wraps existing LLM APIs and runs locally after installing the PyPI package. The tool is suited for teams wanting a lightweight, faster‑to‑import alternative to larger frameworks like LangChain. Its main strength is a 15% quicker import time, while the lack of passing tests and limited community size are notable drawbacks.

github.description: AgentRun is an open-source platform that supercharges your agents. It adds self-improvement, durable execution and a control plane on top of your favorite agent harness. Your agents become smarter, more fault tolerant and use fewer tokens with every run.
